nodes.name: HTTP - WhatsApp Business API

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const j = $json; if (j.template) { return JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', recipient_type: 'individual', to: j.to, type: 'template', template: j.template }); } if (j.image_url) { return JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', recipient_type: 'individual', to: j.to, type: 'image', image: { link: j.image_url, caption: j.body } }); } return JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', recipient_type: 'individual', to: j.to, type: 'text', text: { preview_url: false, body: j.body } }); })() }}

nodes.notes: PROVIDER-SPECIFIC. Verify endpoint, API version and message type against your WhatsApp Business Solution Provider before enabling. Credential supplies Authorization: Bearer <WABA token>.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO publications (schedule_id, platform, platform_post_id, published_at, status, error_detail, raw_response) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'whatsapp', $2, NULLIF($3,'')::timestamptz, $4, $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (schedule_id, platform) DO UPDATE SET platform_post_id = EXCLUDED.platform_post_id, published_at = EXCLUDED.published_at, status = EXCLUDED.status, error_detail = EXCLUDED.error_detail, raw_response = EXCLUDED.raw_response RETURNING publication_id, schedule_id, platform, platform_post_id, status, published_at;
